name: Letter from JW
content:
Robert, if you're reading this letter then you're in the right place. However, we've gone ahead. If you want to join Urb3xInfinite then you have to prove you have what it takes.

After all, we've only spoke online so we need to know you're for real. Don't sweat, we're only going as far as the lower tunnel entrance.|You'll need to make your way to the basement using the elevator and the storage key we nabbed a while back. We left it in the office.

I get that it's a bit involved but it keeps the trash out, if you know what I mean.

You do this, and we're good. We'll explore this whole damn city together.|We'll be waiting with open arms when those elevator doors open brother.

Last thing, power shouldn't be a problem since everything runs off the main school's grid, but it's still pretty dark even on this floor. I hope you brought your flashlight!

- JW.
